author: Learn Linux TV
description:
*Grab your expert guide here* ➜ https://learnlinux.link/ditch-windows

Windows updates keep breaking things - remote desktop, USB audio, shared folders, Outlook. If you're tired of wondering what the next update will break, Linux is a real option. My book Switching to Linux walks you through choosing a distro, testing before you commit, installing, finding software, getting hardware working, and living with it day to day.

#Linux #SwitchToLinux #WindowsUpdate
title: Tired of Windows Updates Breaking Things? Switch to Linux!
